stories.title: Il premio Nobel per la Fisica va a Francis Halzen per gli studi sui neutrini ad alta energia

en.title: Physics Nobel Prize goes to Francis Halzen for studies on high-energy neutrinos
en.summary: Francis Halzen received the Physics Nobel Prize for his research on high-energy neutrinos. The Medicine Nobel was awarded to Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann, and Georg Nagel for foundational work in optogenetics.

stories.title: Francis Halzen vince il Nobel per la Fisica 2026 per gli studi sui neutrini

en.title: Francis Halzen wins 2026 Physics Nobel for neutrino studies
en.summary: Francis Halzen won the 2026 Physics Nobel Prize for his research using the IceCube observatory at the South Pole to detect high-energy neutrinos from space.

stories.title: Sinner salta anche le Finals: “La mia stagione è finita”

en.title: Sinner skips Finals: "My season is finished"
en.summary: World number one Jannik Sinner announced on social media that he will not compete for the remainder of 2026.

stories.title: Sinner: "Il mio ginocchio ha bisogno di cure. Per me il 2026 è finito"

en.title: Sinner: "My knee needs treatment. My 2026 is finished"
en.summary: World number one Jannik Sinner withdrew from the ATP Finals, citing knee issues requiring medical attention.

stories.title: Sinner salta anche le Atp Finals: "Per me il 2026 è finito"

en.title: Sinner skips ATP Finals too: "2026 is finished for me"
en.summary: Tennis world number one Janko Sinner announced via Instagram that he will not compete in the ATP Finals, marking another withdrawal after skipping tournaments in Beijing and Shanghai.

stories.title: Diesel, salta lo sconto sulle accise da 6,1 centesimi. E sale anche il tetto ai prezzi di Eni

en.title: Diesel discount on excise tax of 6.1 cents falls through. Eni price cap also rises
en.summary: A planned reduction in diesel excise taxes was not implemented, and the price ceiling for Eni increased, resulting in a marginal impact on national fuel prices.

stories.title: Nobel per la Fisica 2026 al belga Francis Halzen per la scoperta dei neutrini cosmici

en.title: Belgian Francis Halzen awarded 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for cosmic neutrino discovery
en.summary: Physicist Francis Halzen from Belgium received the Nobel Prize in Physics for discovering cosmic neutrinos, following last year's award for quantum tunneling research.

stories.title: Trump approva la fucilazione di Nidal Hasan, l’autore della strage nella base di Fort Hood

en.title: Trump approves execution of Nidal Hasan, perpetrator of Fort Hood base massacre
en.summary: President Trump authorized the execution of Nidal Hasan, who killed 13 people and wounded 32 others at Fort Hood military base in 2009, following Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's recommendation.

stories.title: Sinner salterà anche le Atp Finals: “Devo curare il ginocchio, per me il 2026 è finito”

en.title: Sinner will also skip the ATP Finals: "I need to care for my knee, for me 2026 is finished"
en.summary: Tennis player Jannik Sinner announced via social media that he requires a treatment cycle for his knee injury, officially ending his 2026 season.

stories.title: Trump approva la fucilazione per l'autore della strage nella base di Fort Hood

en.title: Trump approves execution for Fort Hood shooting perpetrator
en.summary: President Trump approved the execution of Nidal Malik Hasan, who killed 13 people in a 2009 shooting at Fort Hood military base. The Pentagon spokesman announced the decision on social media.

stories.title: È morto Jeffrey Archer, autore di bestseller ed ex politico britannico

en.title: Jeffrey Archer, bestselling author and former British politician, dies
en.summary: British author and politician Jeffrey Archer has died at age 86. During his career, he sold over 300 million books.

stories.title: Ok di Trump alla fucilazione per l’autore della strage di Fort Hood. E sugli spot “patriottici” dice: “Li pago io”

en.title: Trump approves execution for Fort Hood shooting author. On "patriotic" ads he says: "I'll pay for them"
en.summary: Trump approved the execution of Nidal Hasan, who killed 13 people and wounded 32 in a 2009 shooting at Fort Hood. Trump also stated he would personally fund patriotic advertisements in response to allegations of illegal propaganda.

stories.title: Nucleare, Mimit e Mase aprono la corsa delle imprese all’Ipcei: proposte entro il 3 dicembre

en.title: Nuclear, Mimit and Mase open the race for companies in the Ipcei: proposals by December 3
en.summary: The Italian government has launched an industrial initiative for nuclear energy development, inviting company proposals by December 3, following the Senate's approval of nuclear legislation.

stories.title: Firenze, la sinergia spinge i musei, +22% di incassi per il nuovo Gamb

en.title: Florence, synergy boosts museums, +22% revenue for new Gamb
en.summary: The integrated Florence museum system combining the Accademia Gallery and Bargello Museums has exceeded revenue expectations with a 22% increase.

stories.title: Finish Group rileva Termoacustica Pugliese e punta a 20 milioni di ricavi nel 2026

en.title: Finish Group acquires Termoacustica Pugliese and targets 20 million euros in revenue by 2026
en.summary: Finish Group, a construction materials manufacturer based in Puglia since 1956, has acquired Termoacustica Pugliese to strengthen its position in lightweight building systems.

stories.title: Eurovo, tre nuovi stabilimenti per coprire il boom di consumi

en.title: Eurovo, three new facilities to meet consumption boom
en.summary: Eurovo is investing 120 million euros over three years with 53 million already spent on three new facilities to increase production capacity.

stories.title: Conad Adriatico investe 270 milioni in tre anni

en.title: Conad Adriatico invests 270 million euros over three years
en.summary: Conad Adriatico plans to invest 270 million euros across three years, with 75 million allocated in 2027 for store openings and renovations. The company will use artificial intelligence and business intelligence tools to improve profit margins.
